110330401.text: It is just as one expected. The owner of Wanmin Restaurant is indeed a most reasonable and accommodating human.

110330402.text: Still, the work here entails dealing with quite a varied group of people. Has this been difficult for you, Shenhe?

110330403.text: It's been manageable so far. I sometimes run into strange people, but I have figured out a way to deal with them.

110330404.text: Seems like you've been making progress! So by "dealing with them," you mean...

110330405.text: First, I try to talk sense into them. If that doesn't work, I threaten them with violence. At this point, they usually decide they are in favor of a civil conversation.

110330406.text: Uh... How should Paimon put this...

110330408.text: A sensible plan. One is gladdened to see you integrate so well into human society.

110330409.text: And you, Master? How have you been?

110330410.text: Simply marvelous! Though Mt. Aocang has scarcely enjoyed your presence recently, one has hardly found the pleasure of one's own company to be lacking.

110330411.text: I see... Just as expected of Master.

110330413.text: What she means to say is, she actually misses the two of you a lot.

110330414.text: I have missed Master quite a bit, too. Even though work has been busy lately, I've already had a conversation with Chef Mao about taking some time off soon to visit Master.

110330415.text: You did? Ahem, do make note of such matters in your letters in the future. There is hardly a need to keep one in suspense.

110330416.text: Whoa, her mood shot up just like that...

110330417.text: By the way... Master, since you are in Liyue Harbor, have you had the chance to visit Ganyu?

110330418.text: Indeed. She is similarly preoccupied with her work. There was time only to exchange a few simple pleasantries.

110330419.text: Ganyu told us the story of Cloud Retainer's name! It was amazing — we never knew how powerful she was before!

110330420.text: I see. In that case, allow me to also share a story about Master's past.

110330422.text: Is that a problem, Master? I believe this to be a good topic of conversation.

110330423.text: No, not a problem... one was simply caught off guard. But no matter. Please, proceed — one is most curious to see how much of one's own conversational prowess you possess.

110330424.text: Master once participated in a race against Moon Carver. After Moon Carver lost, he insisted that Master's ability to fly gave her a natural edge in such a contest.

110330425.text: In response, Master agreed to forgo flying in return for being able to use one of her devices in the race. Moon Carver accepted, only to find Master with a brand-new device on the day of the contest.

110330426.text: So what kind of device was it?

110330427.text: It was a mechanical vehicle made out of iron. What was it called again... An "Electro-Powered Bicycle"?

110330428.text: You refer to the "Bi-Cyclical Thunderflash-Mobile." One spent forty-nine days conceptualizing and crafting it. It need only be infused with adeptal energy, and it can cover thousands of miles in one day.

110330429.text: It boggles the mind why Moon Carver ever supposed he might best me in a contest of locomotion. Though he sprinted with all his might, he could barely keep up.

110330430.text: Alas, the one flaw of my mechanism lay in its weakness against mountainous terrain. One was thwarted mere seconds from victory, when it was thrown off course and failed to make it across the final stretch... Truly a most unfortunate turn of events... Anyway, do go on, Shenhe.

110330431.text: Master, that was the end of that story.

110330432.text: Is that so? *sigh* With you gone, one has seldom felt the desire to call upon those old fossils for another contest. What is a race without spectators, after all.

110330434.text: Lonely? Hah, at one's age, entire human generations come and go in the blink of an eye. Even one's own self-directed musings can span several days and nights.

110330435.text: Tis a most foreign sentiment. The mere mention of it is preposterous.

110330437.text: Mmm? What is the reason for that look upon your face?

110330438.text: It's nothing! It's just... Well, Paimon gained a lot of respect for you after listening to that story of you summoning the rain and everything. But... all it took was a few words out of your mouth, and it's like you're back to being that illuminated bird again.

110330439.text: Paimon's just a little bit confused... which one of the two is the real Cloud Retainer?

110330440.text: To me, they are both Master. One is the Master that's widely revered by the people, while the other is the Master that I respect and adore.

110330441.text: Hah, one finds oneself exalted yet again with sweet words of praise and flattery of a most extravagant nature. You chose to exalt one with your words, yet you refuse to grace Mt. Aocang with your presence for any extended period of time. One would almost question the sincerity of your estimations.

110330442.text: That is not to say that your words paint an inaccurate picture. One has always lived by a single ideal: eschew all action and abide by no rule. One does as one pleases and speaks as one pleases. Others may critique or praise as they see fit, yet one places little weight in such judgments.

110330443.text: She got like, what, two sentences of flattery from her disciple, and it's as if her ego is about to burst...

110330444.text: Do you have any empty tables?

110330445.text: Hey there! Could we get another Fish Stew?

110330446.text: ...I'm hearing more guests come in. I should get back to work.

110330447.text: Alright! Good luck with the lunchtime rush, Shenhe!

110330448.text: Mhm hmm. I'll try my best.

110330101.text: Here we are! Right outside her place.

110330102.text: Do you still remember the first time we came here? We even brought offerings and everything.

110330103.text: And when we told her that Rex Lapis had been assassinated, she immediately threatened to "squash Liyue Harbor"! Paimon thought she'd be impossible to get along with, but now that we've spent some more time together, she's really not like that at all.

110330104.text: We probably don't need to bring any offerings now that we've gotten to know her pretty well, right? Still, Paimon's got some snacks around here somewhere, so if she really wants something, we can just use that!

110330108.text: Whoa, what a pretty lady! Is she also here to visit Cloud Retainer?

110330109.text: It seems like she could also be a powerful adeptus.

110330110.text: Yeah, you're right... All it takes is one look and you can tell she's someone special! As expected of that bird lady, really. She must have a whole bunch of adepti friends from all over the country!

110330111.text: Okay, but... If we're both friends of Cloud Retainer, then we're basically friends by association, right? Want to go up to her and say hello?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Yuehai Pavilion to meet Ganyu

110330201.text: We're almost at Yuehai Pavilion! Hey, do you think Ganyu will be shocked to see Cloud Retainer like this?

110330202.text: Guess we have no idea if Shenhe and Ganyu have ever seen her in this form before... Wait, where did she go?

110330205.text: Why are you just standing there, Cloud Retainer?

110330206.text: Quietly, now. One shall stay here. You two can go and meet with her.

110330207.text: Huh? But why? Isn't it better if we all go together?

110330208.text: Hmph. If one were to proudly proclaim one's presence, Ganyu would surely profess herself otherwise unoccupied and drop everything to attend to one's visit. One fears that would only result in her staying up all night to make up for lost time.

110330209.text: One does not wish to trouble her. Conversing vicariously via you two shall suffice. Do remember to inquire as to her recent well-being. Again! Do not mention one's presence here.

110330210.text: Fair enough, makes sense. Alright, then we'll just pass on your regards and—

110330214.text: Is that lady someone you know, Ms. Ganyu?

110330215.text: She is indeed. I'm sorry, Huixin, but could we delay the upcoming meeting for a little bit? I believe my schedule today is quite full. Although, perhaps I could move some work to later in the evening...

110330216.text: Not to worry, Ms. Ganyu. I'll make the necessary arrangements right away.

110330219.text: Greetings. What brings you here today? And Cloud Retainer, too... It's been quite some time since I last saw you in this form.

110330220.text: You are quite mistaken. One is not acquainted with this Cloud Retainer of whom you speak. One is simply... a mere mortal passerby!

110330224.text: Ahem, that was... but a simple test. One did not expect you to be able to recognize one so easily, especially after so many years of only seeing one's other form.

110330225.text: (Ganyu looks totally bewildered... She's thinking, "Why wouldn't I recognize you...? I used to see you every day... how bad do you think my memory is?")

110330226.text: But recognizing you is, uh... my responsibility as your disciple.

110330228.text: One was simply passing by while attending to some important business. One thought it would only be fitting to pay you a visit while in the area.

110330229.text: Wait, Paimon wasn't aware of any important— Ohh...

110330230.text: Cloud Retainer's right! We've still got something suuuper important to do, so we can't stay here for too long today.

110330231.text: Is that so... but it's been so long since we last saw each other...

110330232.text: One simply desired to see you and had no intention of interrupting your work. A quick conversation should suffice for today — a more involved reunion should wait until you find yourself less occupied.

110330233.text: I understand. That should be fine...

110330234.text: While one acknowledges the amount of work that you have to deal with every day, one must also remind you to rest. Though adepti blood flows through your veins, excessive exhaustion will still cause grave harm to your body.

110330235.text: Ah, it still makes one nostalgic to see you as you are now, respected and independent. When you were young, you oft begged one to cuddle you to sleep when you suffered from nightmares—

110330237.text: Hm, if you insist. We are running short on time regardless, so one will refrain from going into each and every story. Why don't you continue your conversation? One shall simply stand by and listen.

110330238.text: You discuss some of your recent adventures with Ganyu...

110330239.text: Wow, you've been to so many new places since the last time we spoke. If you ever need anything, please just come find me at Yuehai Pavilion.

110330240.text: Also... Forgive me for my presumptuousness, Miss Cloud Retainer, but if you plan to continue appearing in this form, don't you think it'd be helpful to adopt a human name?

110330241.text: A human name? Hmm, you raise a valid point. Considering the sheer extent of one's renown, "Cloud Retainer" is surely too recognizable as a name.

110330242.text: You really think so? ...Not that you're NOT famous, or anything, but... THAT famous?

110330243.text: Hmph, you presume to know the extent of one's illustrious achievements? One would hardly think such a thing to be possible. Nevertheless, Ganyu's advice cannot be ignored. From this point on, when in public occasions, be sure to refer to one as "Xianyun."

110330245.text: Ah, I assume that's a reference to the "Full Record of Pristine Pavilion."

110330246.text: An adeptus of years past would rise with the clouds and rest with the moon. They were enlightened and wise, free and unfettered. The writer referenced master's name to describe her carefree and spontaneous nature.

110330247.text: Whoa, that sounds super cool! Paimon feels like only the most powerful of adepti could rise with the clouds and rest with the moon!

110330248.text: Actually, those lines were originally written to describe Cloud Retainer herself...

110330249.text: Huh!? Wait, so you're really that powerful?

110330250.text: And what of it? Did you truly take one to be nothing more than a bird of bigger than average size?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Wanmin Restaurant to see Shenhe

110330301.text: You get what I'm saying, right?

110330302.text: Yeah, how can I not? Not even fine food is enough to distract from the presence of a fine lady.

110330303.text: I'm far more interested in getting her details than ordering any dishes. Hey, how about you ask her?

110330305.text: Nonono, I think you should... Wait, she's coming!

110330306.text: What can I get for you today?

110330307.text: Greetings, Miss. I was just wondering... If you'd be willing to—

110330308.text: What would you like to order?

110330310.text: Two servings of Mora Meat to go. ...Good chat, bye!

110330312.text: Welcome. It's been a while. May I take your order?

110330313.text: Don't welcome us as guests and greet us as old friends in the same line! It's weird!

110330320.text: Hah, one does not recall ever revealing this form to you before. How were you able to ascertain one's true identity with such ease?

110330321.text: I've trained and lived with Master for more than ten years. I would recognize you no matter what form you take.

110330324.text: Hardly, hardly. One simply learned of your employment from your letter and came to check on your well-being.

110330325.text: And check out the great food, too!

110330326.text: Indeed, it is almost lunch time... My apologies. I'm still on the clock, and can't talk for very long.

110330327.text: #Well, if it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Are you here for Shenhe?

110330328.text: The lunch rush isn't in yet, Shenhe, so I've got things covered for now.

110330329.text: Go ahead, sit down and enjoy some time with your friends. I'll let you know if things pick up.

110330501.text: As more and more guests begin to trickle in, Paimon takes the opportunity to order a whole array of delicious dishes...

110330502.text: So much yummy food! Paimon's gonna feast!

110330505.text: One is fond of all kinds of delicacies and delights in a multitude of flavors.

110330506.text: The dishes here demonstrate no shortage of culinary skill. Their unique flavor profile has left one more than satisfied. In fact, one has been struck by quite the fit of inspiration. One has already begun to conceptualize the next generation of supreme cuisine machines.

110330507.text: Everything's so tasty... A bit too hot at times, but still super tasty...

110330508.text: I'm sorry, Miss, but our tables are full.

110330509.text: Shall we try somewhere else, Granny?

110330510.text: But it smells so delightful... Can we really not eat here? My poor legs can't go on for much longer.

110330511.text: Well... You could always check with some of the other guests and see if anyone's happy to share a table?

110330513.text: Excuse me, would you mind letting us share a table with you? There are no empty tables left, so...

110330514.text: Ah, well Paimon doesn't mind! What about you guys?

110330801.text: (An elegantly assembled mysterious mechanism. For some reason, it is hard to keep your eyes off of it.)

110330802.text: (It appears to be one of Cloud Retainer's new inventions, but it's hard to tell what it could be used for.)

110331001.text: I wonder where Xiangling's run off to this time...

110331002.text: If you bump into her, please let her know that a new shipment of spices has come in, so it'd be nice if she could come home and take a look.

110339901.text: We've been to so many places lately! What do you say we take a day off from adventuring and just find somewhere nice to relax?

110339902.text: Let Paimon think, where are some nice places we could go... Oh, why don't we pay Cloud Retainer a visit at Mt. Aocang?

110339903.text: It's been a while since we last saw that illuminated bird! She's always the one popping up out of nowhere and scaring us half to death, so let's surprise her this time!

110339904.text: *sigh* Ganyu has been quite busy with work as of late. One can count on one talon the number of times she returns to Mt. Aocang each year.

110339905.text: Shenhe has also secured employment recently. In her correspondence with me, she wrote that she shall have "no need to return for the foreseeable future."

110339906.text: Hmph! Did they think one was so easily mollified? One shall investigate everything with one's own eyes, and decide for oneself if their living conditions are satisfactory!

110339907.text: Phew... Paimon was pretty quick on the uptake there, don't you think?

110339908.text: As soon as you mentioned important business to attend to, Paimon realized that you were just looking to cut the conversation short, and not take too much of Ganyu's time! Is Paimon right?

110339909.text: No, in fact, it was not an excuse. One is indeed visiting Liyue Harbor for an important purpose.

110339911.text: The moment is not yet upon us. Still, the truth will be revealed to you in time.

110339912.text: Huh... She really seems to be playing up the whole mysterious adeptus thing right now... Is it because we just heard that cool story about her powers?

110339913.text: As more and more guests begin to trickle in, Paimon takes the opportunity to order a whole array of delicious dishes...

110339914.text: I've always wanted to try this place...

110339915.text: For this price, the food is unbelievable!

110339916.text: Everyone, please eat to your hearts' content! Today is my treat.
